name: oracle-stale-price
description: Chainlink oracle used without staleness check in lending protocol

ground_truth.title: Stale Chainlink oracle price accepted without staleness validation
ground_truth.root_cause: latestRoundData() result used without checking updatedAt timestamp against a staleness threshold
ground_truth.violated_invariant: collateral must always be valued at a recent, valid price
ground_truth.failure_predicate: protocol accepts stale oracle price (updatedAt > MAX_STALENESS seconds old) for borrowing decisions
attack_path: 1. Chainlink oracle stops updating (sequencer down, oracle malfunction)
2. ETH price was $4000 at last update but current real price is $2000
5. Attacker borrows $2666 (66% of $4000) — but real collateral worth only $1333
6. Attacker walks away with $1333 profit (protocol undercollateralized)

economic_impact.max_extractable: proportional to price discrepancy × deposited collateral
